About Vinkos

Building careers.
Powering business.

Vinkos is an Indian manpower solutions company built to make hiring simpler and employment more accessible.

We work with employers that need dependable talent and people who want transparent, dignified work. Our local-first approach brings practical knowledge of skills, shifts, licences and working conditions into every match.
